messages:
Alex: heads-up: ramped a small canary on the slen gating selector yesterday, saw a ~12% p99 spike for mid-length jobs (256-1024). digging into profiler now.
Maria: logs? which kernel path fired for the p99s — prefill or decode?
Alex: mostly prefill path. fused-kernel-x was selected on H100 hosts; decode path used queued-small-kernel. profiler shows increased L2 thrash and KV cache evictions during the spike.
Devon: hmm could be batching bursts interacting with KV lifetime. what were batch sizes during the canary?
Alex: normal batch target is 8, but traces show bursts up to 16 during peak. attaching a tiny perf summary below.
Alex: ```
perf summary (sample):
 fused_kernel_x (prefill): 45% cycles, mem-bound
 small_decode: 12% cycles
 kv_cache_evictions: +30% during canary
 tail_p99_latency_delta: +120ms
```
Kai: did the autotuner pick fused_kernel_x based on mean latency of historical runs? maybe the window looked like longctx.
Jena: autotune used the seqlen histogram (median ~700) so selector favored the prefill route. but distribution is bimodal — we have a large short-ctx spike around 32 tokens that the median hides.
Sam: that's the core problem — autotune currently uses median/mean and a single threshold. it doesn't detect multimodal distributions or mode-confidence. we should score bins separately.
Maria: +1. propose adding a bin-confidence metric + hysteresis: if confidence below threshold, prefer decode/fallback. also instrument kv_eviction_rate as a hard signal. :thumbsup:
Devon: also note architecture differences — fused_kernel_x is excellent on A100 for longctx, but on H100 for these batch+seqlen combos it's worse due to L2 behavior. we need per-GPU profiles in autotune weights.
Alex: I ran a quick variant that adds a kv_eviction_rate check to the selector; in A/B it reduced p99 by ~9% and lowered token-cost by ~4% (smaller kernels win when eviction oscillates).
Kai: can you paste the selector pseudo-logic you used?
Alex: ```
# simplified selector pseudo
if seqlen_confidence < 0.6:
  choose decode_path
elif kv_eviction_rate > 0.2:
  choose decode_path
elif gpu_family == 'a100' and seqlen > 512:
  choose fused_kernel_x
else:
  choose small_decode
```
Jena: we should persist per-route seqlen histograms and use an EWMA over 5m to avoid reacting to transient spikes. also sample a few traces where kernel_mispick==true to feed into autotune model.
Sam: opened PR #4022 to add per-gpu profiles + bin hysteresis. @Alex can you add a minimal harness to replay the canary traces?
Alex: on it. will add a harness script and tests. scheduling a canary run tomorrow 09:00 PT. logging fields added: `slen_bin`, `kernel_choice`, `kv_eviction`, `batch_sz`.
perf-bot: deploy-canary started by Alex at 2551210000
Maria: thanks — if the canary holds, we push to dedicated pool in the afternoon; if not, rollback. keep the thread updated.
Alex: noted. I'll post a perf summary + flamegraph after the run. thanks all for the quick triage.
